paragraphs.text: Which teaches that the use of the Sabbath stands in praising God, and not only in ceasing from work.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: For God's mercy and fidelity in his promises toward his, bind them to praise him continually both day and night.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: These instruments were then permitted in the Church as also they are now. (Ed.)
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: He shows the use of the Sabbath day: that is, to meditate God's works.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: That is, the wicked do not consider God's works nor his judgments against them, and therefore most justly perish.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Your judgments are most constant against the wicked and pass our reach.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: You will strengthen them with all power, and bless them with all happiness.
paragraphs.label: g
paragraphs.anchor: But my horn shalt thou exalt

paragraphs.text: Though the faithful seem to whither and be cut down by the wicked, yet they will grow again and flourish in the Church of God as the cedars do in mount Lebanon.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: The children of God will have a power above nature and their age will bring forth fresh fruit.
paragraphs.label: i
